translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
translations.en.yusufali: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menurunkannya (Al Quran) pada malam kemuliaan.

transliteration: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tahukah kamu apakah malam kemuliaan itu?

arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
transliteration: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

translations.en.sahih: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
translations.en.pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
translations.en.yusufali: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
translations.id.indonesian: Malam kemuliaan itu lebih baik dari seribu bulan.

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
transliteration: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr

translations.en.sahih: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
translations.en.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
translations.en.yusufali: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
translations.id.indonesian: Pada malam itu turun malaikat-malaikat dan malaikat Jibril dengan izin Tuhannya untuk mengatur segala urusan.

transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

translations.en.sahih: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
translations.en.pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
translations.en.yusufali: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
translations.id.indonesian: Malam itu (penuh) kesejahteraan sampai terbit fajar.
